-- Reaper: unstick any v2 account stuck in GENERATING for >20 minutes.
WITH reaped AS (
  UPDATE "TikTokAccount"
  SET "videoGenStatus" = 'IDLE',
      "videoGenStartedAt" = NULL,
      "nextPostAt" = NOW() + INTERVAL '15 minutes',
      "updatedAt" = NOW()
  WHERE "pipelineVersion" = 'v2'
    AND "videoGenStatus" = 'GENERATING'
    AND "videoGenStartedAt" IS NOT NULL
    AND "videoGenStartedAt" < NOW() - INTERVAL '20 minutes'
  RETURNING id
),
orphans AS (
  UPDATE "ContentItem"
  SET status = 'FAILED',
      "errorMessage" = 'reaped: pipeline did not finish within 20 minutes',
      "updatedAt" = NOW()
  WHERE status = 'PROCESSING'
    AND "createdAt" < NOW() - INTERVAL '20 minutes'
    AND "tiktokAccountId" IN (SELECT id FROM "TikTokAccount" WHERE "pipelineVersion" = 'v2')
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reaped) AS accounts_reaped, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orphans) AS items_marked_failed;

-- Atomic claim: select + update in one statement using SKIP LOCKED so
-- concurrent orchestrator runs cannot double-claim. Joined to the quota
-- function + view so accounts over their monthly cap are skipped.
WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT a.id
  FROM "TikTokAccount" a
  LEFT JOIN account_monthly_usage u ON u."tiktokAccountId" = a.id
  WHERE a."pipelineVersion" = 'v2'
    AND a."nextPostAt" <= NOW()
    AND a."videoGenStatus" = 'IDLE'
    AND a."videosPerWeek" > 0
    AND a."lateProfileId" IS NOT NULL AND a."lateProfileId" <> ''
    AND a."lateAccountId" IS NOT NULL AND a."lateAccountId" <> ''
    AND COALESCE(u.posted_this_month, 0) < dragonmadeit_tier_monthly_quota(a.tier::TEXT)
  ORDER BY a."nextPostAt" ASC
  LIMIT 50
  FOR UPDATE OF a SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE "TikTokAccount" a
SET "videoGenStatus" = 'GENERATING',
    "videoGenStartedAt" = NOW(),
    "updatedAt" = NOW()
FROM eligible e
WHERE a.id = e.id
RETURNING
  a.id,
  a."userId",
  a.tier,
  a."pipelineVersion",
  a."videoType",
  a."voiceType",
  a."storyTypes",
  a."randomizeStories",
  a."videosPerWeek",
  a."lateAccountId",
  a."lateProfileId",
  a."nextPostAt",
  a."videoGenStartedAt";

-- Sub-pipeline error catcher. Runs only if executeWorkflow throws.
UPDATE "TikTokAccount"
SET "videoGenStatus" = 'IDLE',
    "videoGenStartedAt" = NULL,
    "nextPostAt" = NOW() + INTERVAL '1 hour',
    "updatedAt" = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.id }}'
  AND "pipelineVersion" = 'v2'
  AND "videoGenStatus" = 'GENERATING'
RETURNING id;
